description: NHFLOW channel 8 x 1.6 m, h 0.5 m, 0.6 m/s (k-epsilon, bed friction), with a pier 0.3 x 0.3 m through the water column (DIVEMesh solid, A 580 0: its columns have no slice cell), two subdomains; no sediment. The solid columns are dry (nhflow_fsf_f::solid_dry) and their faces are walls: the hydrostatic pressure of the fluid cell in the normal momentum, no other flux (wetdry_fluxes, nhflow_HLL solid_face_flux). Stagnation in front of the pier (0.27-0.43 m/s, depth 0.55 m), 0.5-0.84 m/s beside it, 0.2 m/s in the wake, the same on both sides. Before, the faces of the pier were open or carried extrapolated fluxes: 5-7 m/s behind the pier and up to 2.1 m of water beside it (Dropbox/Claude/Exner Review/validation/07_nhflow_pier_flow).
covers: nhflow_fsf_f::wetdry_fluxes at the faces of solid columns
nhflow_HLL::aij_E closed continuity flux at a solid
